# Lash and Brows Near You - Service à Domicile Privé & Personnalisé à Cotonou

> Private & Personalized At-Home Beauty Salon Service in Cotonou, Benin.

## Overview
Lash and Brows Near You provides premium, certified, at-home aesthetic and beauty treatments delivered directly to clients' homes and hotels across Cotonou and nearby areas in Benin.

## Core Beauty Services
- **Lash Extensions**: Classic Lash Extensions, 2D/Hybrid Lash Extensions, 3D Volume, 4D Mega Volume, Lash Refills.
- **Microblading & Microshading**: Semi-permanent eyebrow shading, combo brows, retouching, and brow correction.
- **Lip Blush**: Semi-permanent lip tinting and pigmentation.
- **Eyeliner & Brow Lamination**: Permanent eyeliner and brow coloration/lamination.
- **Waxing & Sugaring**: Face, chin, upper lip, underarms, arms, legs, and bikini zone hair removal.
- **Manicure & Pedicure**: Gel polish, spa pedicures, simple polish, and nail care.
- **Professional Training**: 1-on-1 accredited masterclasses in Microblading, Lash Extensions, and Brow Lamination.

## Special Promotion & Offer
- **Combo Discount**: Pick 2 services and get **15% Off** (discount applies to all services except standalone Waxing, Manicure, and Pedicure).

## Location & Service Coverage
- **Primary Service Area**: Cotonou, Benin (Home & Hotel delivery across Akpakpa, Haie Vive, Cadjehoun, Fidjrosse, Ganhi, Gbegamey, Agla, Godomey, and surrounding areas).
- **Target Audience**: Women seeking high-end, hygienic, private, convenient aesthetic treatments without salon traffic or queues.
